title: Geometric Move-Potential Representations and Action-Only Discrete Diffusion for Searchless Chess

channel_24_mathematical_specifications.canonical_symmetry_group: Z_2 board-perspective reflection (rank flip y -> 7 - y coupled with color swap White <-> Black when Black is to move)
channel_24_mathematical_specifications.canonicalization_scope: Applied identically in preprocessing to ALL encoders (Flat12, Flat20, ConvPlanes28, Topo44, Shaw2D, and Local-Frame IPA); vertical file reflection (x -> 7 - x) is NOT a general chess symmetry when castling rights are active.

channels_0_to_5_friendly_ray_potentials.blocker_treatment: Strict first-blocker ray attenuation along the 8 compass rays (or exact jump target for Knights/Kings); does NOT pre-filter by king-safety or pin legality.

channels_6_to_11_opponent_ray_potentials.blocker_treatment: Identical first-blocker ray attenuation for opponent pieces.

channels_16_to_19_pin_and_xray_tension.ch_16_friendly_pin_ray_tension: T_{\text{pin}}(u) = \mathbb{I}[\text{single blocker } u \text{ on sliding ray between enemy slider } v \text{ and friendly King } K_{\text{STM}}]
channels_16_to_19_pin_and_xray_tension.ch_17_enemy_pin_ray_tension: T_{\text{epin}}(u) = \mathbb{I}[\text{single blocker } u \text{ on sliding ray between friendly slider } v \text{ and enemy King } K_{\neg\text{STM}}]
channels_16_to_19_pin_and_xray_tension.ch_18_xray_second_blocker_flux_friend: \Phi_{\text{xray,friend}}(u) = \text{sliding attack potential transmitted through exactly 1 intervening piece}
channels_16_to_19_pin_and_xray_tension.ch_19_xray_second_blocker_flux_opp: \Phi_{\text{xray,opp}}(u) = \text{opponent sliding attack potential transmitted through exactly 1 intervening piece}

two_way_interactions.physical_interpretation: Negative/sub-additive interaction confirms that explicit continuous ray-potential input fields and sparse Local-Frame IPA supply partly overlapping chess-displacement inductive bias (+0.2598 under dense Shaw vs +0.0876 under Queen+Knight IPA), while combining both achieves the highest absolute ranking accuracy (tau = 0.7660).

Pure_IPA_Kernel_Under_QueenRays_Cell11_v.description: Matched kernel-only contrast holding Topo44 and QueenRays mask constant (Fixes Item 1)

Pure_IPA_Kernel_Under_QueenKnight_Cell12.description: Matched kernel-only contrast holding Topo44 and Queen+Knight mask constant

Pure_Topo44_Field_Under_QueenKnight_IPA_.description: Matched input-only contrast holding IPA and Queen+Knight mask constant

Pure_Knight_Edges_Under_Topo44_IPA_Cell1.description: Matched mask contrast isolating the 336 Knight-jump edges under Topo44 + IPA

Topo44_Continuous_vs_ConvPlanes28_Binary.description: Continuous 24-ch ray/flux/tension fields vs Czech et al. binary attack/mobility planes (Item 22)

discovered_attack_attention_and_interven.temporal_terminology_note: Relative to Ply 3 (index 2), Ply 1 (index 0) is in the PAST (past-to-present attention from the line-opening move), while Ply 5 (index 4) is in the FUTURE (future-to-past acausal attention from the downstream tactical capture/check goal).

wp_e3_400ply_joint_covariance_tournament.schedule_design: Connected Partial Tournament Schedule (121 of 136 possible 17-player pairings: all 70 neural-vs-Stockfish pairings, all 45 neural-vs-neural pairings, and all 6 adjacent Stockfish-vs-Stockfish ladder pairings)

executable_protocol_specification.stockfish_uci_elo_scale_caveat: Stockfish `UCI_Elo` (anchored at `Stockfish_UCI_Elo_1800 = 1800.0` with SE = 0.0) is an internal engine strength calibration parameter and does NOT directly equal human FIDE or Lichess pool Elo.
executable_protocol_specification.corpus_distillation_spec_1p27m: 1,269,820 deduplicated board positions evaluated via Stockfish 19 MultiPV (50 nodes per legal move, minimum 500 nodes/board; 2,000 test states evaluated with full MultiPV = K_legal at 2,000 nodes/board).
executable_protocol_specification.opening_suite_and_diversity: 100 balanced 8-ply opening positions sampled from the 500-position Silver/Noomen suite; each pairing plays 200 games (100 openings x 2 colors swapped). Neural agents apply softmax temperature tau_temp = 0.15 over legal moves for the first 4 game plies after the book exit and deterministic argmax thereafter, ensuring 200 unique game trajectories per pairing.
executable_protocol_specification.termination_rules: Full 400-ply natural FIDE termination (checkmate, stalemate, insufficient material, threefold repetition, 50-move rule; 0.0% ply-cap adjudication).

wp_e4_synthetic_2d_grid_routing.horizon_truncation_note: 68.4% of test instances have an obstacle-free shortest route through via to sink within <= 6 steps; the remaining 31.6% require 7-10 steps around obstacle clusters. Under a fixed 6-step block horizon, D3PM matches the 6-step prefix of the optimal detour (59.98% step accuracy) but truncates at step 6 (39.87% completion vs 44.40% for 1-step greedy Topo+IPA, a -4.53 pp completion difference).
